fin.margin_monthly.label: family_code
fin.margin_monthly.description: Product family key (CON, TRP, SFA, SSF, ANC, ADH, LAT, DFT).

fin.margin_monthly.label: plant_id
fin.margin_monthly.description: Plant or source of supply (PLT-TRC, PLT-LEB, or the supplier id for bought-in families).

fin.margin_monthly.label: net_sales_usd
fin.margin_monthly.description: Net sales after discounts, rebates accrued and returns, USD.

fin.margin_monthly.label: cogs_steel_usd
fin.margin_monthly.description: Steel and primary material in cost of sales, at standard plus variance, USD. Zero for bought-in families: the supplier price sits in cogs_other.

fin.margin_monthly.label: cogs_duty_usd
fin.margin_monthly.description: Duties and tariffs recognised in cost of sales this month (as inventory turns, not as entries are filed).

fin.margin_monthly.label: cogs_other_usd
fin.margin_monthly.description: Other material (coatings, resin, bought-in finished goods) and unattributed cost.

fin.margin_monthly.label: close_status
fin.margin_monthly.description: Certified, Preliminary, Open. October 2026 is Open - never read as actuals.

fin.std_cost_version.label: cost_version
fin.std_cost_version.description: FY2026 standard, Q2 2026 update, Q3 2026 update - each version kept.

fin.std_cost_version.label: duty_usd_per_unit
fin.std_cost_version.description: Duty at standard, from the duty rate table in force at the version date.

fin.gm_forecast_snapshot.label: net_sales_usd
fin.gm_forecast_snapshot.description: Full-year net sales in the snapshot.

fin.gm_forecast_snapshot.label: gross_margin_usd
fin.gm_forecast_snapshot.description: Full-year gross margin in the snapshot.

fin.gm_forecast_snapshot.label: gm_target_pct
fin.gm_forecast_snapshot.description: Target gross margin for the family from the pricing policy.

sales.invoice_line.label: channel
sales.invoice_line.description: National retail, Dealer, Component manufacturer, OEM, Contractor, Other.

sales.invoice_line.label: list_price_usd
sales.invoice_line.description: List price in force on the invoice date (price_list).

sales.invoice_line.label: net_price_usd
sales.invoice_line.description: Price after contract pricing and discounts; before rebates.

sales.invoice_line.label: price_list_id
sales.invoice_line.description: The list the line priced from.

sales.price_realisation_monthly.label: realisation_pct
sales.price_realisation_monthly.description: net ÷ list x 100. A list increase is not realised until this ratio holds.

sales.rebate_accrual.label: sell_through_confirmed_usd
sales.rebate_accrual.description: Sell-through confirmed by dealer files received.

sales.rebate_accrual.label: sell_through_missing_usd
sales.rebate_accrual.description: Estimated sell-through from dealers whose file has not arrived - never accrued.

sales.rebate_accrual.label: tier_pct
sales.rebate_accrual.description: Rebate tier reached on confirmed year-to-date sell-through.

sales.dealer_sell_through.label: builder_id
sales.dealer_sell_through.description: Builder customer id the sales were made to.

sales.dealer_sell_through.label: file_received_on
sales.dealer_sell_through.description: Date the dealer's file arrived. Null = not received; the month is not confirmed.

proc.po_line.label: fixed_price_lot
proc.po_line.description: True when the line belongs to a fixed-price lot schedule (Taichung, Formosa).

proc.goods_receipt.label: entry_id
proc.goods_receipt.description: Customs entry the receipt cleared under, for imports.

proc.supplier_invoice_line.label: unit_price_usd
proc.supplier_invoice_line.description: Invoiced unit price - can differ from the PO price; the difference is a price variance, not an accepted increase.

proc.supplier.label: category
proc.supplier.description: Steel, Wire, Anchors, Tools, Coatings, Resin, Freight, Broker, Services.

proc.supplier.label: contact_email
proc.supplier.description: Account manager email - PII, masked for Data Analyst.

proc.supplier_contract_term.label: term_type
proc.supplier_contract_term.description: Price change notice, Duty pass-through, Fixed-price lot, Minimum order, Index adjustment, Incoterm.

proc.supplier_contract_term.label: notice_days
proc.supplier_contract_term.description: Days of notice the clause requires.

proc.supplier_contract_term.label: share_pct
proc.supplier_contract_term.description: Share the supplier bears under a pass-through clause.

proc.supplier_contract_term.label: valid_to
proc.supplier_contract_term.description: End of the term (fixed-price lots end 2026-12-31).

proc.supplier_contract_term.label: recorded_by
proc.supplier_contract_term.description: Procurement owner who recorded the term.

proc.supplier_price_notice.label: valid_from
proc.supplier_price_notice.description: Earliest date the contract allows: received_on + notice days under the price-change clause.

proc.supplier_price_notice.label: source
proc.supplier_price_notice.description: Letter, Portal, Email (recorded by procurement only when accepted).

proc.supplier_price_notice.label: accepted
proc.supplier_price_notice.description: Recorded as accepted by procurement. An email stays unaccepted until then.

trade.customs_entry.label: steel_content_value_usd
trade.customs_entry.description: Declared value of steel content for the Section 232 line.

trade.duty_line.label: program
trade.duty_line.description: IEEPA, Section 301, Section 232 steel content, MFN.

trade.duty_line.label: chapter99_code
trade.duty_line.description: Chapter 99 HTS line the duty was entered under; null on 14 lines (declaration rejected).

trade.duty_line.label: recoverable
trade.duty_line.description: True for IEEPA lines on entries to 20 Feb 2026. Section 301 and 232 are never recoverable.

trade.mill_certificate.label: entry_id
trade.mill_certificate.description: Entry the certificate supports. 38 entries have no certificate on file.

trade.mill_certificate.label: melt_country
trade.mill_certificate.description: Country of melt and pour stated on the certificate.

trade.refund_declaration.label: state
trade.refund_declaration.description: Refunded, Claimed, Rejected, Not filed - four states, never collapsed.

trade.refund_declaration.label: rejection_reason
trade.refund_declaration.description: Why the declaration failed validation, where it did.

trade.duty_rate_table.label: basis
trade.duty_rate_table.description: Customs value or steel content value.

pricing.price_change_event.label: STATUS
pricing.price_change_event.description: Proposed, Approved, In effect, Lapsed. A proposed increase is not a price.

pricing.customer_agreement.label: RENEWAL DATE
pricing.customer_agreement.description: Renewal date - the first date terms can change.

pricing.customer_agreement.label: DOCUMENT REF
pricing.customer_agreement.description: Controlled document in the agreements folder.

pricing.agreement_term.label: TERM TYPE
pricing.agreement_term.description: Notice period, Increase cap, Increases per year, Qualifying costs, Justification period, Freight, Price fixed until.

pricing.agreement_term.label: VALUE NUM
pricing.agreement_term.description: Numeric value where the term has one (days, percent).

pricing.builder_program_tier.label: REBATE PCT
pricing.builder_program_tier.description: Rebate at and above the threshold.

supply.steel_index_monthly.label: USD PER TON
supply.steel_index_monthly.description: Month average, USD per short ton.

supply.steel_inventory.label: WEEKS OF COVER
supply.steel_inventory.description: tons_on_hand ÷ weekly_consumption. Excludes tons on order.

supply.steel_purchase.label: INDEX AT PURCHASE
supply.steel_purchase.description: HRC index the month of purchase.

supply.plant_capacity.label: QUALIFIED
supply.plant_capacity.description: True when the plant is listed on the family's code report. Capacity without qualification cannot ship.

eng.code_report_plant.label: PLANT REF
eng.code_report_plant.description: Plant id or supplier plant name listed.

eng.code_report_plant.label: STATUS
eng.code_report_plant.description: Listed, Inspection scheduled, Inspection requested, Not listed. Only Listed is coverage.

eng.change_request.label: KIND
eng.change_request.description: Plant move, Supplier change, Material substitution.

eng.change_request.label: CODE REPORT GATE
eng.change_request.description: Open, Inspection scheduled, Cleared. A move cannot ship until Cleared.
